block-guide:
YOAST/FAQ-BLOCK (Yoast FAQ) A list of questions and answers. Yoast SEO adds FAQPage and one Question per answered question to the page's structured data. The block exists only while Yoast SEO is active. Use it for a real FAQ section of the page. EACH QUESTION IS WRITTEN THREE TIMES In the comment, per question: "question" / "answer" (what the editor shows) and "jsonQuestion" / "jsonAnswer" (what goes into the structured data); in the HTML, the same text again. - The editor checks the HTML against question / answer: a different text = invalid block. - The structured data reads ONLY jsonQuestion / jsonAnswer: a question without jsonAnswer is left out of FAQPage, and an outdated json text is published while the page shows another. Keep all three equal, as the editor does; "images":[] when the answer has no image. MARKUP (the shape the Yoast editor saves)

- The HTML is one line: no spaces or line breaks between the elements. - id: unique on the page ("faq-question-" + a number; the editor uses the time in ms). It is the section's HTML id and the #anchor of the Question in the structured data. - An answer may hold inline HTML (strong, em, a). In the comment the editor writes < > & as < > &: "answer":"Two to four working days." - Questions take only italic, strikethrough and links in the editor. PITFALLS - Change a question in all three places at once (question, jsonQuestion, the ); the same for an answer (answer, jsonAnswer, the

). - Several FAQ blocks on one page feed the same FAQPage; do not repeat a question. - The page's type in the structured data becomes ["WebPage","FAQPage"]. CHECK Page source: the yoast-schema-graph script lists one Question per answered question with the text you wrote. Reopen the editor: the block shows no invalid-content warning.
